generic_lessons: Use a minimal controlled signed change to qualify an uncertain native mutator, then a distinct exact remaining precondition change; preserve both results and never replay an unknown mutation.
Resource-shortage evidence needs current stock, actual native cost and separate visible/full eligibility at the write boundary, plus actual alternative production.
A resource-free candidate remains legal during a shortage of a different resource. Do not interpret shortage as every production path stopping.
After ordinary accumulation restores eligibility, verify that existing legal production retains progress instead of being canceled or replaced.
Repeated native completion notifications do not prove two assets or two requests. Cross-check dispatch records and actual object identity.
Keep higher Core/UI stock discrepancies explicit. Do not invent a conversion or infer an exact debit from incompatible snapshots.
A normal end ACK can leave the same turn or enter a diplomacy modal. Read back the real state and handle ordinary player UI before claiming turn advancement.
